title: Heroes   Chest Autofarm
features:
!!!! This script requires a GOOD executor to run.
If you're going to use ServerHopOnTimeout and ServerHopOnKick, make sure to place the script in your auto-execute folder !!!!

features below:

MaxWaitTime: Waits up to the set time (in seconds) for a chest to spawn before server hopping.
ServerHopOnKick: Automatically switches servers if you get disconnected.
ServerHopOnTimeout: Changes servers if no chest is found after the max wait time.
LowGraphics: Reduces visual quality to improve performance.
DisableRendering: Turns off 3D rendering.
MaxFPS: Limits the game’s FPS.
RedeemCodes: Automatically redeems the codes listed for rewards.
